title: Aelian, Various History 3.18 (English, Thomas Stanley, 1665)

source.publisher: Internet Archive ("Aelian - Various History", scan of Thomas Stanley's 1665 translation)

summary: Aelian (about 200 CE) preserves Theopompus's tale of Silenus telling Midas of an unseen continent beyond the Ocean, with the warlike Machimus and the pious Eusebes. The Meropis story is often compared with Plato's Atlantis.

tree.title: Aelian, Various History 3.18: Theopompus on Silenus, Midas and the continent beyond the Ocean
tree.summary: Silenus tells Midas that Europe, Asia and Libya are islands in the Ocean and that a boundless continent lies beyond, with giant men and two great cities, the warlike Machimus and the pious Eusebes. Machimus once sent a huge fleet toward our lands, found us unremarkable and turned back.
